fee_notes: Single $50,000 Initial Franchise Fee. Additionally, $7,500 Activation Fee (one-time, even for multiple shops). Development Fee for multi-unit: $85,000 for 2 shops; $35,000/shop for 3-4; $30,000/shop for 5-10. All fees non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: All franchisees must pay to us a $50,000 lump sum "Initial Franchise Fee" when they sign a franchise agreement for a Millie's Shop.
